messages:
maddie.z: FYI vendor says they're ready for the assessment on Tue. We need one-off rules for artifact sharing and a hard retest blackout window for prod deploys. Thoughts?

tony.h: Agreed. For artifacts let's add a visible watermark line with assessor-id + artifact-hash and keep originals encrypted offline. That way any leaked copy is traceable.

ria.c: Watermarking is fine, but don't leak secrets in the watermark. Use a short GUID and the SHA256 prefix of the sanitized file. Example: "PT-ASSR-42::SHA256:9f8a..."

maddie.z: Perfect. Also ops asked about deploy freeze: propose no non-critical deploys from 24h before first retest slot until the final retest completes. We'll add emergency rollback playbook if a hotfix must go out.

sre-oncall: We can vendor a lock via feature-flag gating and hold a single emergency CD path. Need to know what constitutes "critical". Recommend severity >= P0 only.

security-bot: REMINDER: Create ticket SEC-PT-2027 with artifact manifest, watermark mapping, and list of ephemeral roles before any keys are rotated.

tony.h: On KMS: use a wrap-only key policy for the ephemeral unwrap role. Do not grant kms:GenerateDataKeyPlain to assessors. Provide kms:Decrypt only via a temporary STS session policy. Log kms:Decrypt events and copy logs to the evidence bucket.

ria.c: We'll include a minimal IAM sample in the ticket. Also adding a requirement: assessors must assume role using SAML tag assessment_id=pt-2027 so we can correlate CloudTrail entries.

maddie.z: Retest scheduling: vendor requested two validation runs. We have limited infra. Propose prioritizing critical vulns daily, everything else in a weekly batch. If vendor requests extra run, they must submit a slot request with CWE references.

sre-oncall: We can reserve an afternoon slot 14:00-16:00 and a morning 09:00-11:00 for the week of the engagement. If more capacity needed, we'll queue and notify by email/calendar.

tony.h: Add telemetry smoke test checklist for retest: 1) health-check endpoints respond, 2) telemetry spans emitted for relevant services, 3) log lines present with sanitized IDs, 4) synthetic users exercise patched code paths. If any check fails, tag the retest as invalid.

ria.c: Also capture a small log sample (sanitized) and a trace snippet to attach to the Jira ticket for validation. Use an artifact name that matches the watermark.

maddie.z: Communication: create #pt-ops-updates as read-only, and DM assessors for role handoffs. Include a one-line summary in the exec channel after every retest.

security-bot: ACTION: Add checklist item "ACL snapshot + artifact-watermark mapping" to SEC-PT-2027.

tony.h: I'll author the wrap-only KMS policy and the short presign script: `aws s3 presign s3://pt-evidence/<file> --expires-in 3600` plus a note to rotate links if reused.

ria.c: I'll prepare the IAM trust policy with SAML tag requirement and the one-time credentials rotation steps.

sre-oncall: I'll reserve the infra slots and notify infra-owners. Also prepping small perf profile to ensure retest doesn't trigger autoscale flaps.

maddie.z: OK team, let's attach the scripts and policies to SEC-PT-2027 and meet Monday for a 15-min sync. If blockers show up, ping here. :mag::lock:
